definitions.explanation: Opening remarks placed at the front of a book or paper, explaining its aim and background. A formal term found mainly in academic and scholarly works.

examples.japanese: {著者|ちょしゃ}は{緒言|しょげん}で{研究|けんきゅう}の{目的|もくてき}を{述|の}べている。
examples.english: The author states the purpose of the research in the preface.

examples.japanese: {専門書|せんもんしょ}の{緒言|しょげん}には、その{分野|ぶんや}の{背景|はいけい}がまとめられていることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The preface of a specialist book often summarizes the background of the field.

notes:
A formal, written-language word used chiefly in academic books and papers. Also read ちょげん. In everyday writing まえがき or はじめに are far more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {序文|じょぶん}: preface — a near-synonym; {緒言|しょげん} sounds more academic.
- まえがき: foreword — the plain, everyday equivalent.
- あとがき: afterword — the closing counterpart placed at the end.
